description:
EXCEPTIONAL FIVE BEDROOM HOME WITH STUNNING GROUNDS


Savills are delighted to present Entwood, Bailick Avenue, Midleton, an exceptional five-bedroom detached family home extending to approximately 3,336 sq ft (310 sq m) and occupying a magnificent 0.67-acre landscaped site. Discreetly positioned in a private cul-de-sac of quality homes, Entwood combines generous accommodation, exceptional presentation and an impressive level of specification and technology.

The property was comprehensively renovated in 2014, with the works including replacement windows, walls, floors and ceilings, together with extensive upgrading throughout. Underfloor heating provides warmth throughout, supported by an oil-fired central heating system and a stove with back boiler. Further significant investment in 2024 included a complete roof replacement incorporating additional insulation, 20 solar panels and a 10kW battery storage system.

At the heart of the home is an impressive open-plan kitchen, dining and sitting area. The superb kitchen features a large island with quartz worktops and an extensive range of integrated appliances, while the dining area enjoys a wonderful connection with the gardens through a large glazed sliding door. The adjoining sitting area features a stove and stylish drinks cabinet. Also on the ground floor is a generous lounge, large study/sitting room, fifth double bedroom and an outstanding ensuite which also serves as the guest WC. A particularly spacious utility room and dedicated communications room complete this level.

Upstairs are four further double bedrooms, including a magnificent principal suite with private balcony, extensive fitted wardrobes, separate dressing room and beautifully appointed ensuite. The remaining bedrooms are generously proportioned and served by an impressive family bathroom. Reflecting the owners' technology background, Entwood benefits from extensive Cat 6 cabling, sophisticated Wi-Fi infrastructure, CCTV, alarm, automated gates and an electric vehicle charging point.

The beautifully landscaped gardens are a particular feature. Mature trees including cherry, weeping willow and silver birch sit alongside bamboo, ferns, shrubs and extensive planting. A striking fish pond with cascading water provides a beautiful focal point, while the large patio enjoys excellent southwest-facing sunshine. The covered outdoor entertaining area incorporates recessed lighting, Bose speakers and infrared heaters, creating a superb space for year-round enjoyment.

Added in 2024, the impressive garden room incorporates a sauna and large glazed sliding doors overlooking the gardens, creating a private wellness retreat. A large two-bay garage with automated doors and robot lawnmower further enhance the property. Located approximately 200 metres from the Midleton Greenway, with excellent schools and Midleton town close by, Entwood offers an exceptional combination of space, privacy, lifestyle, technology and convenience.
